witness.description: Table of n_a = min{m>=1 : phi(m)=a} for every a in im(phi) intersect [8,50], recomputed by the verifier by exhaustive scan m<=256 with exact integer arithmetic. The witness below carries the claimed table; the verifier independently rederives image, least preimages, ratio bound, anchors, and max location, and raises on any mismatch (fail-closed).

claim: verify(witness) returning True (any inconsistency raises VerifyFailure, exit nonzero) establishes L1's full finite content: (i) exact image im(phi)∩[8,50] is the 17 listed values with the five listed gaps; (ii) each listed n_a is the true least preimage, reconfirmed by exhaustive scan m≤256 plus per-a leastness check; (iii) n_a/a ≤ 15/8 for every a in the image, attained exactly at a=8; (iv) all six anchors hold. covers='full' of L1's finite scope; the asymptotic branch-A proposition itself is NOT stamped. No imports, no I/O, no floats, fail-closed, deterministic.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
